card.name: The start of manifest-/manufact- words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split word that begins with 'man', such as MAN in MANIFESTED or MANIFESTATIONS, 'man' in manufacturing, or Man in Mania. It is most common in all-caps label headings.

modes.description: The piece 'man' that starts manufacturing or manufactory in ordinary prose.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with a 'man' piece that begins a longer word, and it pushes away factory and manifest words.
card.plain: It fires on the opening 'man' of words like manifestations, manufacturing and mania when they are split up.
